methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
Therefore, the objectives and main contributions of this paper are as follows: (a) to propose an
approach for the evaluation of resource utilization capability in EnMS; (b) to identify the needed
processes and resources for operation of an EnMS; (c) to classify resource utilization opportunities
based on importance and efficiency; and (d) to prioritize resources and the recommend strategic
decisions aimed at increasing resource utilization capability.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: EnMS resource-utilisation assessment only; no energy-use EnPI or EnB measurement model is identified or characterised.

paper_type.evidence_quote: In addition, an oil refinery is considered as a case study.

stage1.notes: The refinery case is empirical, but the model evaluates EnMS resource utilisation rather than energy performance.
